blockedIdentities.reason: The recorded official domain icmemotori.com no longer resolves in DNS (checked 2026-09-10), and icme.it is a parked domain offered for sale. No other live manufacturer-owned HTTPS page for ICME S.p.A. could be found, so the profile has no available authoritative source until the company publishes a new site.
IKS Group of Companies is used by unrelated industrial and service organisations. The repository record lacks a legal-name, domain or product-scope discriminator.

ILMVAC is a legacy vacuum-equipment company identity associated with later Gardner Denver and Welch portfolio changes. No current standalone manufacturer-owned identity and product source was available.
IMS is a generic abbreviation used by multiple unrelated industrial manufacturers and service companies. The raw record contains no safe identity discriminator.

Indramat is a legacy drive and control brand integrated into Bosch Rexroth. The combined INDRAMAT REXROTH record is not a distinct current manufacturer identity and requires canonical legacy handling.

Innovari is documented as a former grid-software and demand-management company rather than a current industrial manufacturer. Current ownership and product continuity cannot support a standalone manufacturer profile.
INOTEC is used by unrelated manufacturers of mixing equipment, RFID labels, emergency lighting, connectors, plastics and process plants. The undifferentiated record cannot be assigned safely.
Internormen Technology is a legacy filtration company acquired by Eaton. Current first-party material did not establish it as a standalone active manufacturer brand suitable for a separate SAFE page.

profiles.shortDescription: HYDRO LEDUC manufactures hydraulic pumps, motors, accumulators and customized fluid-power components.
fullDescription: HYDRO LEDUC's official site identifies a French hydraulic manufacturer founded in 1938.
Its documented range includes piston pumps and motors, hydropneumatic accumulators, micro-hydraulic components and custom solutions for mobile, industrial and aerospace applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Hydro-Mec manufactures gearboxes and geared motors for industrial power-transmission applications.
fullDescription: Hydro-Mec's official site documents an Italian drive-technology manufacturer founded in 1983.
The published range includes worm, helical, bevel-helical, shaft-mounted and planetary gear units together with geared-motor configurations and accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Hydro-Vacuum manufactures pumps, pumping systems and water-management equipment for municipal and industrial applications.
fullDescription: Hydro-Vacuum's official site identifies a Polish pump manufacturer with industrial roots dating to 1862.
Its range includes centrifugal, multistage, sewage and deep-well pumps, pumping stations, pressure-boosting systems and fire-fighting pump sets.

profiles.shortDescription: Hydronit develops compact hydraulic power units and integrated electro-hydraulic systems for mobile and industrial equipment.
fullDescription: Hydronit's official site identifies an Italian hydraulic power-unit manufacturer established in 2003.
Its documented portfolio includes modular mini power packs, brushless and variable-speed units, manifolds, tanks, valves and configured systems for mobile machinery and industrial automation.

profiles.shortDescription: Hydrotechnik develops measurement instruments, sensors and test systems for hydraulic and fluid-power applications.
fullDescription: Hydrotechnik's official site documents a German measurement-technology manufacturer founded in 1964.
The product range covers mobile measuring devices, pressure, flow, temperature and speed sensors, data-acquisition systems, test benches and diagnostic software.

profiles.shortDescription: Hyperline develops structured-cabling, fibre-optic and data-centre connectivity products for communications infrastructure.
fullDescription: Hyperline's official site documents a connectivity-products brand established in 1994.
Its portfolio includes copper and fibre-optic cabling, patch panels, cabinets and racks, data-centre containment, power-distribution units and installation accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Hypertac is a Smiths Interconnect brand for hyperboloid-contact connectors used in high-reliability electrical systems.
fullDescription: Smiths Interconnect's official product site identifies Hypertac as a current high-reliability connector technology and brand.
The documented portfolio includes circular, rectangular, modular and high-power connectors using hyperboloid contact technology for demanding industrial, transport and medical applications.

profiles.shortDescription: I.S.T. Molchtechnik manufactures pipeline pigs and pigging-system components for cleaning, separating and inspecting pipelines.
fullDescription: I.S.T. Molchtechnik's official site identifies a German specialist manufacturer for pipeline pigging technology.
Its product range includes foam, sealing, cleaning and gauging pigs, pig launchers and receivers, tracking equipment and customized pigging components.

profiles.officialName: IBEDA Sicherheitsgeräte und Gastechnik GmbH & Co. KG

fullDescription: IBEDA's official site documents a German gas-technology manufacturer founded in 1960.
Its range includes gas mixers, flashback arrestors, non-return valves, pressure regulators, gas manifolds, safety devices and testing equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: ICI Caldaie manufactures industrial boilers, heat-recovery equipment and thermal-energy systems.
fullDescription: ICI Caldaie's official site identifies an Italian boiler manufacturer founded in 1958.
Its portfolio includes steam, hot-water and diathermic-oil boilers, heat-recovery generators, burners, water-treatment equipment and integrated thermal-plant solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: ICP DAS develops industrial automation, remote I/O, data-acquisition and communication products.
fullDescription: ICP DAS' official site documents a Taiwanese industrial-automation manufacturer founded in 1993.
Its portfolio includes programmable automation controllers, remote I/O modules, industrial computers, data-acquisition devices, gateways, industrial Ethernet and wireless communication products.

profiles.shortDescription: Official material for ID Insert Deal identifies pressure regulation, filtration and lubrication equipment for compressed air and technical gases as its principal product areas. Aihamyn Hampa Trading handles specification-led RFQs without implying an authorised relationship.
fullDescription: Official ID Insert Deal information confirms a product scope centred on pressure regulators, filters, filter-regulators, lubricators, decompression units and relief valves for compressed air, gaseous and liquid fluids. Brand origin: Italy, formed in 2004 from the merger of Insert (compressed-air and pressure-regulation equipment, founded in the 1970s) and Deal (gas regulators and manifolds, founded in the early 1980s).

The official product structure includes Pressure Regulators, Filters, Filter-Regulators (FRL), Lubricators, Relief Valves and Decompression Units/Plants. Model status, options and operating limits remain subject to the applicable manufacturer document.

The source-backed application scope covers chemical, fire-fighting, food and beverage/packaging, oil and gas/energy, and pharmaceutical/cosmetic/laboratory sectors. Aihamyn Hampa Trading uses the submitted specification to review the requested configuration and commercial path.

profiles.shortDescription: IDEC manufactures industrial control, automation and safety products for machines and production systems.
fullDescription: IDEC's official corporate site identifies a Japanese control-equipment manufacturer founded in 1945.
Its product portfolio includes switches and indicators, relays and timers, PLCs, HMIs, power supplies, sensors, safety products and automation components.

profiles.shortDescription: Idroteck designs and manufactures hydraulic cylinders, power units and customized hydraulic systems.
fullDescription: Idroteck's official site identifies an Italian hydraulic-equipment manufacturer.
Its product and engineering scope includes standard and special hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic power units, manifolds and integrated systems for mobile and industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: IEK develops electrical distribution, automation, lighting and infrastructure products for buildings and industry.
fullDescription: IEK's official international site documents an electrical and automation product group established in 1999.
The published portfolio includes low-voltage distribution devices, enclosures, wiring products, industrial automation, lighting, cable-management and telecommunications infrastructure.

profiles.shortDescription: igus manufactures engineered-polymer motion components, including energy chains, bearings, cables and linear systems.

profiles.shortDescription: IKO manufactures needle bearings, linear-motion guides and precision positioning equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: ILAPAK manufactures horizontal and vertical form-fill-seal machines and integrated packaging systems.

profiles.shortDescription: ILC manufactures centralized lubrication systems, pumps and metering components for machinery and mobile equipment.
fullDescription: ILC's official site identifies an Italian lubrication-system manufacturer founded in 1975.

profiles.shortDescription: IMA develops processing and packaging machines and complete automated lines for pharmaceutical, food and consumer products.
fullDescription: IMA's official corporate site identifies an Italian industrial-machinery group founded in 1961.
Its portfolio covers pharmaceutical processing and packaging, tea and coffee packaging, food and dairy equipment, personal-care and consumer-goods packaging and automated end-of-line systems.

profiles.shortDescription: IMAV Hydraulik manufactures hydraulic valves, manifolds and control blocks for mobile and industrial systems.
fullDescription: IMAV Hydraulik's official site identifies a German fluid-power component manufacturer.
Its documented product range includes cartridge and CETOP valves, pressure and flow-control valves, hydraulic manifolds, sandwich plates and customized control blocks.

profiles.shortDescription: IMI TA is an IMI Hydronic Engineering product brand for balancing, control and pressure-maintenance equipment in hydronic systems.
fullDescription: IMI's official climate-control site documents TA technologies within its hydronic balancing and control portfolio.

profiles.shortDescription: INA is a Schaeffler brand for rolling bearings, linear systems, engine components and precision motion products.
fullDescription: Schaeffler's official product material identifies INA as a current industrial and automotive component brand.

profiles.shortDescription: Inbal Valves manufactures butterfly valves, check valves and actuated flow-control packages for industrial systems.
fullDescription: Inbal Valves' official site documents a flow-control manufacturer within Bermad Group.
Its product portfolio includes resilient- and metal-seated butterfly valves, dual-plate check valves, pneumatic and electric actuation and packaged valve-control solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Inductotherm manufactures induction melting, holding, heating and pouring systems for metals processing.
fullDescription: Inductotherm's official site documents a US induction-technology manufacturer founded in 1953.
Its product range includes induction melting and holding furnaces, power supplies, automated pouring systems, vacuum induction equipment and control systems for ferrous and non-ferrous foundries.

profiles.shortDescription: Infastaub manufactures dust collectors and filtration systems for dry industrial processes.
fullDescription: Infastaub's official site identifies a German dust-filtration manufacturer founded in 1967.
Its product range covers cartridge, bag, cassette and panel filters, containment systems and customized dust collectors for pneumatic conveying, bulk handling and process ventilation.

profiles.shortDescription: Infineon develops semiconductor products for power conversion, automotive electronics, sensing, connectivity and security.
fullDescription: Infineon's official corporate site identifies a German semiconductor manufacturer established in 1999.
Its portfolio includes power semiconductors, microcontrollers, sensors, connectivity devices, memory and security solutions for automotive, industrial, energy and consumer applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Manufacturer-owned sources place Injecta in pumps and pumping systems, measurement and instrumentation, and industrial automation and control. The verified brand record is associated with Italy. Submit the exact designation for an international sourcing review.
fullDescription: The verified Injecta record is based on official company and product material covering pumps and pumping systems, measurement and instrumentation, industrial automation and control, and filtration and water systems. Brand origin: Italy. Headquarters: Rieti, Italy. The official company record dates its foundation to 1989, evolving from MIXO, which had built electromagnetic dosing pumps since the 1970s.

Documented lines include Electromagnetic Dosing Pumps, Motor-Driven (Electromechanical) Dosing Pumps, Peristaltic Pumps, Dosing Controllers and Panel Systems, Measurement Probes and Sensors, and Chemical-Dosing/Electrolysis Systems. Their presence helps route an RFQ but does not prove current production, interchangeability or a particular configuration.

Injecta materials reference water and wastewater treatment, swimming pool and spa maintenance, and industrial and cleaning processes. Aihamyn Hampa Trading reviews each enquiry on its own specification and does not infer availability from this profile.

profiles.shortDescription: innomatec develops leak-testing, flow-testing and functional-test equipment for industrial production.
fullDescription: innomatec's official site identifies a German test-system manufacturer founded in 1983.
The documented range covers leak and flow testers, calibration equipment, test benches, quick connectors and automated special-purpose test systems.

profiles.shortDescription: INOXIHP manufactures high-pressure plunger pumps and water systems for industrial cleaning and process applications.
fullDescription: INOXIHP's official site identifies an Italian high-pressure pump manufacturer founded in 1989.
Its product range includes stainless-steel and standard plunger pumps, pump units, pressure regulators and engineered high-pressure water systems.

profiles.shortDescription: INTEGRAL HYDRAULIK's documented product scope includes hydraulic equipment, industrial valves and flow control, and contract manufacturing and fabrication. Official documentation names Hydraulic Power Units, Electro-Hydraulic Control Systems, Hydraulic Test Stands, Hydraulic Cylinders, Control Blocks and Pressure Relief Valves. Commercial review starts with the complete model or specification.
fullDescription: Aihamyn Hampa Trading identifies INTEGRAL HYDRAULIK through its own published sources - now hosted on the Rupf Industries group site after the brand's own integral-hydraulik.com domain went offline - and limits this profile to hydraulic equipment, industrial valves and flow control, and contract manufacturing and fabrication. Brand origin: Germany. Headquarters: Willich, Germany. INTEGRAL HYDRAULIK GmbH & Co. KG remains its own legal entity (Amtsgericht Krefeld, HRA 5030), with its own general partner, Integral Hydraulik Verwaltungs GmbH.

INTEGRAL HYDRAULIK publishes information for Hydraulic Power Units, Oil Supply Systems, Central Drive Stations and Electro-Hydraulic Control Systems (its Systems & Equipment line), Oil Conditioning and Functional Test Stands, and Hydraulic Cylinders, Control Blocks and Pressure Relief Valves (its Components line). A commercial enquiry is therefore matched to the requested designation rather than inferred from the family name.

Documented application areas include energy and power plant technology, steel mills, foundries and coking plants, special machinery, and water engineering / hydraulic steel structures. Buyers should provide the operating context together with the exact model or part number.

profiles.shortDescription: Intel designs and manufactures processors, accelerators, networking products and semiconductor platforms for computing systems.
fullDescription: Intel's official corporate site identifies a US semiconductor company founded in 1968.
Its product portfolio includes client and server processors, graphics and AI accelerators, network and edge platforms, programmable devices and supporting chipset and connectivity technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Interpump Group manufactures high-pressure piston pumps and hydraulic components for industrial and mobile equipment.
fullDescription: Interpump Group's official site identifies an Italian industrial group founded in 1977 around high-pressure pump technology.
Its documented businesses cover high- and very-high-pressure piston pumps, power take-offs, hydraulic pumps, cylinders, valves, hoses and other fluid-power components.

profiles.shortDescription: IPCO manufactures steel belts and industrial process systems for continuous production and material handling.

The portfolio includes solid and perforated steel belts, belt-based cooling, freezing, granulation, casting and laminating systems, press systems and related tracking and service equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Ipsen manufactures industrial heat-treatment furnaces, vacuum systems and process-control software.
fullDescription: Ipsen's official site identifies a heat-treatment equipment manufacturer founded in 1948.

profiles.shortDescription: IREM manufactures power-quality equipment, voltage stabilizers and hydroelectric generating systems.
